questions.stem: Pointing to a man in a photograph, Vinod said, 'He is the brother of my wife's mother.' How is the man related to Vinod?

questions.stem: From a point, a man walks 5 km East, then 12 km North. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: 5-12-13 right triangle: distance = √(25 + 144) = √169 = 13 km.
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem: A man walks 10 km North, then turns east and walks 10 km, then turns south and walks 5 km. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: Net North-South: 10 − 5 = 5 km North. Net East-West: 10 km East. Distance = √(5² + 10²) = √125 ≈ 11.18 km.
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem:

Conclusions: I. All apples are bright. II. Some bright things are apples.
questions.explanation: Both follow by direct subset chain.

questions.stem:
Statements: Some doctors are scientists. All scientists are researchers.

Conclusions: I. Some doctors are researchers. II. All doctors are researchers.
questions.explanation: I: Some doctors ⊂ scientists ⊂ researchers ⟹ some doctors are researchers. TRUE. II: 'Some' ≠ 'All'. FALSE.
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem: If A > B = C and C > D, which is DEFINITELY TRUE?

questions.stem: In a row of 35 children, A is 12th from the left and B is 18th from the right. How many children are between them?
questions.explanation: A is at position 12 from left. B is at position 35−18+1 = 18 from left. Between = |18 − 12| − 1 = 5.
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem: Six friends sit around a circular table facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B is to the immediate right of A. C is opposite to B. E is between A and F. Where does F sit?
questions.explanation: 6 seats. Positions clockwise: A(1), B(2), C(3), D(4), F(5), E(6) — back to A. A opposite D ✓. B right of A ✓. C opposite B ✓. E between A and F (E(6)-A(1) and E(6)-F(5)) ✓. So F sits between E(6) and D(4).
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem: If 14 March 2025 is a Friday, what day is 14 March 2026?

questions.stem: A cube of side 4 cm is painted on all 6 faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many small cubes have at least 2 faces painted?

Question: Who is the youngest among A, B, C, D?

Statement I: A is younger than B, but older than C.
Statement II: D is older than B.

questions.stem: What is the author's overall view on India's healthcare system?
questions.passage_context: India's healthcare system is at a critical juncture. The country has made significant strides in the past two decades — increased life expectancy, lower infant mortality, and successful vaccination campaigns including the world's largest COVID-19 immunisation drive. Yet major gaps persist. Public spending on health remains under 2% of GDP, well below the 5% target. Rural areas continue to suffer from doctor shortages and inadequate infrastructure. Out-of-pocket expenditure pushes millions into poverty each year. The Ayushman Bharat scheme, which provides health insurance to over 500 million low-income citizens, marks a major step forward. Yet quality of care varies widely between empanelled hospitals. Achieving universal health coverage will require sustained investment in primary care, training more medical professionals, and ensuring quality standards are uniformly enforced.
options: It has fully achieved universal coverage
It has made significant progress but faces persistent challenges
questions.explanation: Tone is balanced — celebrates progress but identifies gaps.
questions.subject: ENGLISH

questions.stem:
Rearrange and identify the FIRST sentence.

(A) Today, India ranks among the top FinTech hubs.
(B) Indian banks were among the earliest to adopt mobile banking.
(C) The launch of UPI in 2016 was a turning point.
(D) UPI is now used by over 300 million Indians.
(E) The next phase will focus on cross-border payments.
questions.explanation: B (intro: early adoption) → C (UPI turning point) → D (current scale) → A (current ranking) → E (future). 1st = B.

questions.stem:

questions.explanation: A (intro) → B (cost evidence) → C (current adoption) → D (challenge) → E (closing call). Last = E.
